reddit.title: Optimizing Flowing Water Costs in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. Previously, drying a single cell would trigger a full map rescan, resulting in lag. Now, with our latest update, drying one cell only refreshes its immediate neighbors, drastically reducing processing time from about 20 ms to just 12 ms for a 64×64 lake. This means smoother gameplay and less frame hitching. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Flowing Water Optimization Update
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major optimization for flowing lakes in Provincia! By limiting the processing of wet cells to just their immediate neighbors, we've reduced the time it takes to refresh the game state, resulting in a smoother experience. This change cuts down the lag significantly, allowing you to build and manage your colony with ease. For more details, check out our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
